article.title: -(으)면 안 되다 prohibición
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
article.chapter: Deseo, obligación, permiso y capacidad — 희망·의무·허가·능력

claims.summary: The NIKL guide treats **-(으)면 안 되다** as a unitary expression and documents the forms **찾으면/가면/놀면 안 되다**. The construction conveys prohibition; the guide cautions that it is not formed as **-으면 되지 않는다**. This entry is limited to those forms and the documented prohibition.
